description: This file defines the 'QueryFilter' class used for filtering display data based on entities such as Manufacturer within the shopping web application.

classes.name: QueryFilter
classes.description: A data model class representing filter criteria used in category and search functionalities, encapsulating filter code, id, and type.

methods.name: getFilterCode
methods.description: Returns the filter code used to identify entities in filtering operations.

methods.name: setFilterCode
methods.description: Sets the filter code used for filtering entities.

methods.name: getFilterId
methods.description: Returns the filter id corresponding to a specific entity.

methods.name: setFilterId
methods.description: Sets the filter id for filtering purposes.

methods.name: getFilterType
methods.description: Returns the type of filter being applied, represented by 'QueryFilterType'.
